Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief yet. The scheduler refused my request because the Gateway's automation service needs credentials that aren't configured here (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`). Nothing is scheduled, so there won't be a 07:45 post tomorrow until that's fixed. Someone with Gateway access will need to configure the auth, or you can ask me again once it's working.

When it's set up, I plan to:
- Post at 07:45 America/Chicago each weekday morning, starting Thu 15 Oct. Say if you want weekends too.
- Summarise only new messages from #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford.
- Leave out finance figures such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values and invoice amounts. Operational facts like seat counts, dates, ticket numbers and contacts can stay in.

The people in #strategic-random (you, Gideon and Nadia) are all already in #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford, so the brief won't show them anything new. If membership in #strategic-random changes, I'll need to check the brief again.
